parameters.description:
`mastodon-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `mastodon` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Mastodon URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a status to your own Mastodon account by posting a native Mastodon payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Bearer access token
